decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane. TGR Haas F1 Team changed the setup of Car 87 under Parc Ferme, without the approval of the Technical Delegate, this not being in accordance with Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations. The F1 car is therefore required to start the Sprint from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
fact: The setup of the car has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
